scope: Focused primary-source checks of dependency-map claims, not an architecture comparison or exhaustive literature search.

sources.claim: Training-time feedback/masks and direct token prediction matter; hidden feature prediction is not a universally beneficial auxiliary.
sources.local_implication: Teacher and recurrence semantics must be reviewed for the chosen architecture; no automatic hidden-MSE adoption.

sources.claim: Parallel block drafting and position-dependent loss decay have their own factorization and runtime costs.
sources.local_implication: Depth weighting is a compatible present experiment, not evidence that its schedule transfers unchanged across architectures.

sources.claim: BitNet b1.58 report concerns native ternary training, not a demonstrated binary conversion recipe for this drafter.
sources.local_implication: Do not infer our binary QAT recovery, source readiness or throughput from its model benchmarks.

sources.claim: Consecutive weight-group quantization trades error against extra quantization metadata.
sources.local_implication: Motivates explicit group-scale costing; supplies no current binary-A8 acceptance or native speed result.
